svg.title: OpenDFX for Printed Circuit Boards, by Chris Denney
svg.desc: The cover, on a charcoal background. At the top, the OpenDFX logo's symbol, an open solder jumper with two copper pads inside a white outline on a green square, beside the title in white, with the subtitle and the author below it. Below them, a real circuit board drawn in the book's colors: gold copper pads, green solder mask over traces, white silkscreen outlines and reference designators, and black drilled holes. It is The Public Radio's circuit board, with its round speaker cut-out in the middle.
